ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. This section is for nonresidential, undergraduate, nondegree off-campus students only, on-campus students should register for the on-campus section. Meets March 17-May 7, 2014. This is an accelerated 8 week course and may require more time commitment per week than a traditional 16 week course. Note: For registration questions, please contact the Peggy Day (Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning), at pcday@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
